title: 金色星花
subject: a small five-pointed honey-gold star-shaped flower with plump softly rounded petals and a tiny warm coral-red circular flower center, growing on one short thick sage-green stem with a single broad leaf. The star flower is the large main object, no other flowers, no sparkle, not a metallic star badge, no face
